name: QC Failures
query:
SELECT
 name AS "QC:Link/Optical QC:130",
 optical_job AS "Job:Link/Optical Job:130",
 customer_name AS "Customer::160",
 qc_date AS "Date:Date:100",
 rejection_reason AS "Rejection Reason::170",
 defects AS "Defects::260",
 remake AS "Remake:Link/Optical Remake:130"
FROM `tabOptical QC`
WHERE result = 'Fail'
ORDER BY qc_date DESC
